2026-10-03 landed: PR #15 merged as 7c23941f. origin/main now contains local main up to c05a0811 (via merge b1805d6e) plus the design-golden fix 7ff8e609; all hosted CI green (full repository 46m). PR #14 (TemplateSphereFilesSuite hang-bound timeout) also landed (8bd5bcf7).
Remaining: local main is 5 commits ahead, none on origin: 447a19e4, e6eb79d0, d727969c (the PHRF integration and follow-ups, held for PHRF-21), fa6bd6a9 (design-review graphics) and 45173e2c (fit preparation, new since the snapshot). Local main is not an ancestor of origin/main, so the next sync is a merge of origin/main into local main. It is expected to be conflict-free: origin's side is c05a0811 + PRs #11-#15. Its result then needs the same PR route. I did not touch the shared checkout's local main (about 217 uncommitted paths from active sessions). Keep this ticket open until those 5 commits land.
